description: Replies people wrote back to the brand's Find affiliates messages, newest first, ten a page: what they said, what kind of reply it is (yes, question, other, no, unsubscribe), LinkJolt's drafted answer while it waits (draftAnswer), whether it can be answered from your inbox (answerable) and whether something already went back (answered). waiting: true lists only the replies that still need an answer. Each reply's messageId is what answer_prospect_reply takes. Requires Pro plan or higher.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (ten replies a page)

waiting.description: Only replies that can be answered and have had nothing back yet (default false)

name: list_prospect_replies
title: List replies from found people
